visual_brief.subject: persistent background agents and governed ongoing work
verified_context: OpenAI describes Dots as persistent agents with their own cloud computers that can keep several projects moving in the background.
The engineering significance is the control plane around ongoing work: permissions, background-action limits, approval boundaries, auditability, and interruption.
The illustration must represent persistence and governed access without depicting literal software interfaces, robots, credentials, or security claims.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: Persistent delegated work continues inside bounded spaces while a governed central workspace remains the stable control point.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: A luminous central chamber is connected by one restrained terracotta causeway to a separate bounded workspace across a rocky landscape, making persistence and governed separation physical rather than diagrammatic.

candidate_notes.A: Rejected before scoring: robotic work arms make the scene too literal and violate the constitution's robot prohibition.
candidate_notes.B: Constitution-compliant layered workrooms and thresholds. Strong physical presence, but secondary detail competes with the persistence metaphor at thumbnail size.
candidate_notes.C: Selected replacement after visual QA. A luminous governed hall is physically separated from a bounded secondary workspace by one terracotta causeway. The composition is asymmetrical, text-free, non-robotic, materially detailed, and readable at both article and thumbnail crops.

crop_review.article_desktop: The 1400 × 788 wide hero keeps the luminous central chamber, the bounded side workspace, the terracotta causeway, and enough rocky context to preserve the architectural metaphor without crowding the focal point.
crop_review.article_mobile: A centered narrow crop preserves the glowing central chamber and the terracotta connection while retaining enough of the secondary workspace to communicate governed ongoing work.
crop_review.reference_layout: The physical building masses, cutaway depth, rocky foreground, negative space, and restrained terracotta path keep the composition editorial and architectural rather than schematic.
crop_review.thumbnail: At small scale the bright central chamber, dark rock mass, and horizontal terracotta causeway remain a distinct silhouette.

golden_reference_comparison: Compared palette, warm paper field, graphite restraint, terracotta emphasis, architectural mass, negative space, physical depth, focal hierarchy, and thumbnail silhouette against the current production reference set.
